vision: Explore becomes a calm, content-first discovery field on the cream #FCFAF5 canvas: one Fraunces h1 line, a live search bar, a small gold-ceremonial Featured strip, then ONE continuous grid of person-led palace cards â€” no explainer cards, no compass ornament, no tabs, no publish modal, no frosted glass. Every card has honest, full-size tap zones; every social deep link resolves; anonymous visitors get one conversion door. Me stops being a 9-drawer filing cabinet: 6-7 tabs (6 on iOS), Profile answers 'who am I here' in one screen with a link to the public self, Security becomes the real security page (MFA/password/export/delete/blocked), Cookies folds into it, Sharing becomes the ONE answer to 'who can see what', Subscription answers only 'what am I on'. Everything speaks Atrium canon: ink #403B36 / muted #716A5E type, hairline #E3D6BC borders in rem, ember #B85C38 = interactive, gold = ceremony and focus rings only, warm-ink shadows, one reduced-motion-guarded entrance, 2.75rem touch floor, i18n x5 locales. iOS stays sealed free-tier throughout.

summary: Explore today buries its content under two viewports of self-promotion, carries a 500-line publish system that already exists verbatim in Settings, ships several guaranteed-404 links, and paints every button in the wrong (gold) color. Me is nine drawers where identity, security and marketing are shuffled together, with real bugs (a copied invite link that 404s, a push toggle that dies if you dismiss a prompt, a Discard that doesn't discard). The plan: Phase 1 fixes every broken link and data bug, deletes the dead weight, and dresses Explore in the Atrium canon with a search that visibly works. Phase 2 collapses Me to 6-7 findable tabs, makes Security the real security page, slims Profile, guts the pricing grid, and merges Explore's duplicate cards into one honest, thumb-sized card. Phase 3 turns Explore into one calm Featured-plus-grid feed on a cached data layer, unifies Follow, fixes the visit/profile loop, and enforces the 2.75rem touch floor across the whole public seam. Phase 4 converges everything on one sharing page and one profile presentation â€” your Me page becomes the mirror visitors see, plus an Edit button and one quiet settings door. Roughly 1,500+ lines of duplication and marketing are cut, every tap target meets the 60+ floor, and the iOS free-tier seal is treated as untouchable throughout.
